description: FIBO 派生预处理语义索引(v1 实锚轮)。锚定 FIBO master_2026Q3(2026-10-20 发布)与 OMG Commons:每概念带真实 IRI,definition 含原文;FIBO 无对应类者 source=engineering-approximation、iri 留空。不做运行时 RDF/OWL 推理(OD-004)。锚点核实记录见 docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-21-fibo-ontology-calibration.md。

concepts.label: Payment
concepts.definition: 为履行义务而交付金钱,如清偿一项请求或债务(FIBO 原文:delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation, such as to satisfy a claim or debt;父类 Occurrence)。注意:支付是履行,不是义务本身

concepts.label: Payer
concepts.definition: 支付账单或费用的一方,或为部分/全部履行义务而向收款方付款的一方(FIBO 原文:a party who pays a bill or fees, or who makes payments to a payee in partial or complete fulfillment of an obligation;父类 Obligor——是角色,不是主体)

concepts.label: Payee
concepts.definition: 应收债务的一方,或按其指示汇票/本票/支票可付,或将从付款方处收到付款的一方(FIBO 原文:a party to whom a debt should be paid, or to whose order a bill of exchange, note, or check is made payable...;父类 Obligee)

concepts.label: PaymentObligation
concepts.definition: 按合同条款支付一笔款项的可依法强制执行义务(FIBO 原文:legally enforceable duty to pay a sum of money according to the terms stated in a contract;父类 Commitment+Duty)。与 Payment 的区别:义务是应然,支付是履行

concepts.label: PaymentEvent
concepts.definition: 涉及为履行义务而交付金钱的事件,恰好涉及一个 Payment 并适用于一个 PaymentObligation(FIBO 原文:an event that involves delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation;父类 TransactionEvent)

concepts.label: Account
concepts.definition: 与常规交易和服务的业务安排相关联的记录容器(FIBO 原文:container for records associated with a business arrangement for regular transactions and services;父类 FinancialRecord)。注意:FIBO 把账户建模为记录容器,不是资金容器

concepts.label: Balance
concepts.definition: 可用或所欠的金额,计入借贷及费用后的净额(FIBO 原文:amount of money available or owed;父类 MonetaryAmount——余额是特定时点的净额,不是泛化金额)

concepts.label: Party
concepts.definition: 自然人或组织(OMG Commons 原文:person or organization;父类 Agent)。注:FIBO 已将 Party 迁至 OMG Commons(cmns-pts),FIBO 本体内仅保留 PartyRole 等补充

concepts.label: TransactionEvent
concepts.definition: 销售、转让、租约、许可、贷款、垫款、出资或其他对财产(有形/无形)或金钱权益的转移(FIBO 原文:any sale, assignment, lease, license, loan, advance, contribution, or other transfer of any interest...;父类 OccurrenceKind)。注:FIBO 无裸 Transaction 类,交易语义统一为 TransactionEvent

concepts.label: Obligation
concepts.definition: 施加于某个体的、实际存在的义务(FIBO Duty 原文:some obligation which exists and is imposed on some individual)。注:FIBO 用双概念族表达义务——Duty(法律侧)+Commitment(承诺侧:a promise made by some party to act or refrain from acting);PaymentObligation 为二者交叉

concepts.label: Contract
concepts.definition: 有行为能力各方自愿达成的、同意受法律约束并付出对价的协议(FIBO 原文:voluntary, deliberate agreement between competent parties to which the parties agree to be legally bound, and for which the parties provide valuable consideration;父类 Agreement)

concepts.label: Identifier
concepts.definition: 唯一标识其所关联之物的字符序列(OMG Commons 原文:sequence of characters uniquely identifying that with which it is associated;父类 Designation)。注:FIBO 已迁至 OMG Commons(cmns-id)

concepts.label: MonetaryAmount
concepts.definition: 以货币单位表示的金钱量度的测度(FIBO 原文:measure that is an amount of money specified in monetary units;父类 ScalarQuantityValue)。语义上必须区分 authorized/captured/settled 语境——三者在 FIBO 中分别是授权保留(工程近似)、支付实例、交易终局化

concepts.label: Currency
concepts.definition: 交换价值的媒介,以其负责的货币当局的地理位置为参照定义(FIBO 原文:medium of exchange value, defined by reference to the geographical location of the monetary authorities responsible for it;父类 MeasurementUnit)

concepts.label: LifecycleStatus
concepts.definition: 指示某物在其生命周期特定时点位置或状态的分类器(FIBO 原文:classifier indicating the position or state of something at a particular point in its life-cycle)。注:FIBO 无裸 Status 类,状态语义挂靠生命周期

concepts.label: Authorization
concepts.definition: 对资金在履约前实施的可撤回保留(支付 API 语境)。注意:FIBO 无对应类(code search 实测,命中均为 Commons BusinessAuthorizations 的 import)——本概念是工程近似,近邻 OMG Commons BusinessAuthorizations(cmns-bauth,业务授权语义)与 FIBO Payment/Settlement。授权额度 ≠ 已扣款额度

concepts.label: Capture
concepts.definition: 把已授权额度实际转为扣款的动作(支付 API 语境)。注意:FIBO 全仓无 Capture 类(实测 0 命中)——卡支付 PSP 流水线术语,FIBO 不建模;本概念是工程近似,近邻 FIBO Payment(资金交付)

concepts.label: Settlement
concepts.definition: 使交易终局化的行为,包括但不限于完成记账、交换对价、依法登记单据(FIBO 原文:act of finalizing a transaction, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents)。结算 ≠ 扣款完成

constraints.description: 退款不得超出已扣款金额(候选不变量,P5+ 由 persistence 门执行侧落地)
结算金额不得超出已扣款金额
分录借贷合计相等(复式记账不变量候选)
